area_description: Lubuk Gaung Port, Indonesia
description: While the vessel was loading palm kernel shells at berth, the watch helmsman discovered two perpetrators rummaging through the spare parts room in the engine room. The watch helmsman immediately made an emergency call to the ship. The perpetrators fled towards the wheelhouse and jumped overboard from the stern deck upon being noticed. They escaped via a small boat waiting nearby. The crew then conducted a search on board. Some spare parts of the generator were stolen. The crew were not injured. The incident was reported to Polairud Marine Police. The Marine Police carried out information gathering on the ship.

area_description: Southwest of Vung Tau Light house, Anchorage H13, Vietnam
description: At Anchor While at anchor, at least one perpetrator boarded the ship through freeboard on port bow and went to the paint store at forecastle. A thorough search was conducted on board. 75 cans of paints and a set of cables for welding machines were stolen. The crew were not injured. The incident was reported to the local agent and Vung Tau Border Defence Force.

area_description: Chittagong Port, Bangladesh
description: While berthed, the vessel’s shore security watchman and duty crew detected three to four perpetrators near the port- side midship store. The alarm was immediately raised, alerting the crew and security personnel. Upon activation of the ship’s alarm, the perpetrators escaped. A search was conducted and ship stores, including an emergency hydraulic hand pump, hydraulic blowers and spare PV valves, were stolen from the midship store. Investigation revealed the perpetrators gained access to the vessel from the seaside using hooks and ropes, and subsequently forced entry into the locked midship store. The crew was not injured. The Bangladesh Coast Guard (BCG) subsequently boarded the vessel to conduct further investigation.

area_description: Jakarta Anchorage Zone E, Indonesia
description: At Anchor While anchored, two perpetrators wearing T-shirts and shorts boarded the ship from a small boat using a rope and hook via the poop deck port quarter. The alarm was raised and the perpetrators escaped with stolen engine store spares. The crew was not injured.

area_description: Malacca Strait
description: While the vessel was transiting the Malacca Strait prior to its arrival in Singapore, the third Engineer discovered that the spare store had been disturbed and immediately reported the incident to the Chief Engineer. A subsequent inventory check confirmed that two turbocharger service kits, two main bearing metal assemblies, one crankpin bearing metal, and one piston ring set were missing. All crew members were accounted for and safe. The incident was reported to the flag State.

area_description: Bahodopi Anchorage, Indonesia
description: At Anchor While anchored, during routine safety rounds, the duty AB discovered that perpetrators boarded the vessel. The crew conducted a thorough search of the vessel. However, no perpetrators were found onboard. Subsequent onboard checks revealed that several items were stolen from the bosun store, including a brass bell, electrical wires and cables, butterfly nuts, stools, a chain locker sounding cap, a sounding pipe, and a hydraulic oil refilling cap. All crew members were safe and accounted for. The Master reported the incident through the local agent to the local Port Authority.

area_description: Charlie Anchorage, Chittagong Port Area, Bangladesh
description: While underway, a group of perpetrators boarded the vessel and stole ship stores. As this was a vessel to be scrapped, there was no security staff or watchmen onboard. The ship's local agent informed BCG and Chittagong Port Authority. BCG sent a boarding party to the vessel and conducted an investigation onboard. BCG and River Police subsequently recovered and handed over the stolen items to concern authority and shipping agent.

area_description: Approximately 9.7 nm off Pulau Iyu Kecil (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the Traffic Separation Scheme (TSS)
description: While underway, five perpetrators armed with a knife and a in the engine room. Ship's gun-like object were sighted general alarm was activated, deck lights switched on and all crew mustered. A search was conducted with no further sighting of the perpetrators onboard. All crew were accounted for and were safe. Some engine spares were stolen. The incident was reported to Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS). Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch carried out to warn vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the Singapore Strait (SS). Republic of Singapore Navy (RSN) and Singapore Police Coast Guard (SPCG) were notified of the incident. SPCG boarded the vessel and conducted a security search. No perpetrators were found on board. Information was shared with the Indonesian authorities.

area_description: Belawan Anchorage, Indonesia
description: At Anchor While anchored, the duty officer onboard noticed several small boats near the forward of the vessel and notified the bosun to check. After several minutes, on not receiving any response from the bosun, the duty officer raised the alarm. Crew mustered and proceeded to the forecastle where they saw the bosun tied up. Seven perpetrators carrying knives were also seen escaping from the forecastle store. On investigating, ship properties were reported as stolen. The incident was reported to Belawan VTS, Coast Guard and the local agent.

area_description: Approximately 25.4 nm off Pulau Bintan (Indonesia)
description: While underway, the barge was boarded by three perpetrators. Four lashing wires, eight turn buckles, one solar light and 10 shovels were stolen. The crew on the tug boat were not injured.

area_description: Manila International Container Terminal (MICT) Anchorage, Philippines
description: anchored, four perpetrators armed with knives/bladed weapons boarded the vessel by climbing a rope attached to the forecastle area. Upon boarding, the perpetrators proceeded to the bosun store and forcibly opened the door. After the incident was discovered, the crew immediately secured the area and activated the alarm. Some ship property/stores were stolen. The incident was reported to Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS) Manila and Coast Guard Station (CGS) Manila. Upon receiving the report, Coast Guard Sub-Station (CGSS) North Harbor and CGS Manila personnel, together with Investigation Detection Unit (IDU) personnel carried out investigation.

area_description: Approximately 3.2 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, four perpetrators were sighted in the engine room. One of the perpetrators carried a gun-like object and three perpetrators were unarmed. The ship’s general alarm was activated, deck lights switched on and the crew was mustered. A search was conducted, with no further sighting of the perpetrators onboard. All crew members were accounted for and safe, with no injuries reported. Some further assistance was engine spares were missing. No required. The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authorities. Upon arrival at Eastern Holding A Anchorage (AEHA), SPCG boarded the vessel and conducted a search onboard, with no perpetrators found.

area_description: Approximately 1.9 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, two unarmed perpetrators were sighted on deck by crew. The ship’s general alarm was activated, and all crew members were mustered and accounted for. The crew further was not injured and nothing was stolen. No assistance was required. The incident was reported to VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti- piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authority. Upon arrival at Pilot Eastern Boarding Ground B (PEBGB), SPCG boarded the vessel and conducted a search onboard, with no perpetrators found.

area_description: Approximately 2.3 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, three perpetrators armed with knives and gun-like objects were sighted in the engine room. The ship's general alarm was activated and the crew mustered. A search was conducted, with no further sighting of the perpetrators onboard. All crew members were accounted for and safe. Some engine spares were missing. No further assistance was required. The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authority. Upon arrival at AEHA, SPCG boarded the vessel and conducted a search onboard, with no perpetrators found.

area_description: MICT Anchorage, Philippines
description: At Anchor While at anchor, four perpetrators armed with guns and the ship knives were sighted onboard. Upon discovery, immediately reported to VTMS Corregidor and CGS Manila. The perpetrators disembarked via an unidentified motor banca. In response, CGS Manila immediately informed CGSS North Harbor to establish communication with the subject vessel. Despite several attempts, the station failed to get in touch with the vessel or the local agent for the exact location or other details pertaining to the perpetrators’ identity.

area_description: MICT Anchorage, Philippines
description: At Anchor While at anchor, six perpetrators boarded the vessel via a small motor banca. Upon being discovered, one of the suspects displayed a firearm tucked at his waist and ordered the crew member to raise his hands. The crew, after being threatened, immediately fled to the bridge and reported the incident. Approximately 30 drums of 20L Paint, four pieces of copper screw from the cover of the Bosun Store and three copper fire hose nozzles were stolen. The VTMS Corregidor of Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) coordinated with CGSS North Harbor on the incident. Upon receiving the information, personnel of the substation immediately proceeded to CGSS Navotas to assist the IDU personnel conducting the investigation and communicating with the Master of the vessel.

area_description: Approximately 5.3 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, a perpetrator with knife was sighted in the engine room workshop. The perpetrator attempted to threaten the engine room watchkeeping staff, who ran away and secured himself in the engine control room. The master was informed and the general alarm was activated. All crew mustered and a search was conducted, with no further sighting of the perpetrators. The crew members were not injured and nothing was stolen. No assistance was required and the vessel continued its voyage. The agent of vessel reported to Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA). Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN’s Maritime Security Task Force (MSTF) and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authorities.

area_description: Chittagong Outer Anchorage, Bangladesh
description: At Anchor While at anchor, the deck watchmen observed eight to ten perpetrators armed with long knives boarding the starboard aft deck. One of the perpetrators advanced aggressively, forcing the watchmen to retreat to the port quarter who then raised the alarm. The officer of the Watch (OOW) immediately notified the Master and crew. The ship attempted to contact the Bangladesh Navy and Port Control but with no response. The OOW then observed the perpetrators fleeing from the starboard quarter in two long wooden boats. A subsequent search confirmed no perpetrators remained onboard, but 2900 litres of assorted paint were stolen. The crew were not injured. The incident has been reported to local authorities as well as MPA (flag State).

area_description: Sandakan Anchorage, Malaysia
description: At Anchor While at anchor, during a routine verification of hydro blower specifications for the enclosed-space equipment listing, the training Master was unable to locate the hydro blowers in the forecastle store. Subsequent checks with the crew confirmed that four hydro blowers, one pneumatic blower, one helicopter Rescue Equipment Box, and one coil of tiger rope were missing. The store lock was also found to have been broken. The crew were not injured and no assistance was required. A review of CCTV footage was inconclusive, as visibility was compromised by glare from the forecastle floodlight and forward tube lights. No intruders were captured on the recordings. The incident has been reported to the authorities by the local agent. The Superintendent of the ship also reported the incident to MPA (flag State).

area_description: Approximately 3.6 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, a crew member sighted four perpetrators with knives in the engine room. The ship’s general alarm was activated. All crew mustered and accounted for. A search was conducted with no further sighting of the perpetrators. The crew members were not injured and some engine spares were stolen. The incident was reported to Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS). Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the Singapore Strait (SS). The RSN’s MSTF and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authority.

area_description: Approximately 6.3 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, one perpetrator was sighted in the engine room. The ship’s general alarm was activated. All crew mustered and accounted for. A search was conducted with no further sighting of the perpetrators. The crew members were not injured and nothing was stolen. The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authority.

area_description: In the precautionary area of the TSS
description: While the tug boat towing barge was underway, the Chief Officer noticed a sampan and two perpetrators sighted onboard the barge. The perpetrators subsequently left the barge, and escaped in the sampan. Some scrap metals were stolen. The crew members were not injured. The vessels continued their voyage, with the master declaring that no assistance was required. The incident was reported to MPA (flag State). Singapore Port Operations Control Centre (POCC) confirmed that this information has been shared with the RSN’s MSTF, SPCG and Indonesian authority.

area_description: Outer Anchorage B, near beaching area of Chittagong, Bangladesh
description: At Anchor While at anchor, the crew observed unauthorised persons on deck and alerted the bridge. The general alarm was sounded and all crew mustered. Upon detection, the perpetrators fled and jumped into a small boat. A thorough search was conducted. The paint store lock was damaged and 10 cans of paint were stolen. The crew members were not injured. The incident was reported to MPA (flag State).

area_description: Northeast of Pulau Karimun Besar (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, the Master sighted two perpetrators boarding the barge. The perpetrators were not armed. The crew were not injured. Some mooring ropes and packed goods from the container were stolen, which include building materials and automotive products.

area_description: Waters off Barangay Cuta, Batangas City, Philippines
description: At Anchor While grounded, five perpetrators carried knives boarded the vessel. The perpetrators threatened the crew while escaping. Some metal parts and generator wirings were stolen. One crew member promptly reported the incident to CGSS Batangas City when the perpetrators had already fled the vicinity. Upon receiving the report, CGSS Batangas City deployed personnel to render necessary assistance. All five perpetrators were arrested and sent to the station for investigation.

area_description: Bahodopi Anchorage, Indonesia
description: At Anchor While at anchor, the ship was boarded by the perpetrators. Some brass items such as fire hose coupling, nozzles, cargo light wires, ship’s bell and butterfly nuts inside the Bosun Store were stolen. The crew were not injured. The incident was reported to the National Search and Rescue Agency of the coastal State.

area_description: Approximately 3 nm off Pulau Nongsa (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, the Master observed a sampan alongside the barge, with approximately two perpetrators on board. The perpetrators subsequently escaped from the barge via the sampan. The perpetrators were not armed. The crew were not injured. Some scrap metals were stolen. The incident was reported to MPA (flag State).

area_description: Approximately 3 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, four perpetrators were sighted in the engine room. One of the perpetrators carried a knife, and another perpetrator a gun-like object and knife. The ship's general alarm was activated and crew mustered. After conducting a search onboard, master confirmed there was no further sighting of the perpetrators and some engine spares were stolen. All crew members were accounted for, with no injuries reported. The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authority. The SPCG boarded the ship for security checks at Singapore anchorage, with no perpetrators found onboard.

area_description: Manila North Anchorage, Philippines
description: At Anchor While at anchor, three perpetrators were sighted onboard by the deck watch. Upon noticing the approaching crew, the perpetrators jumped overboard. The perpetrators gained access by climbing the anchor chain, passing through the hawse pipe via a small gap, and pushing the hawse pipe cover open. A thorough inspection was carried out and confirmed that no items were stolen. The perpetrators were not armed. The crew were not injured. The incident was reported to MPA (flag State).

area_description: Approximately 5.7 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, four perpetrators armed with long knives were sighted in the steering gear room. The ship's general alarm was activated and crew mustered. After conducting a search onboard, master confirmed there was no further sighting of the perpetrators and nothing was stolen. A crew was slightly injured by the perpetrators with a minor laceration to his head, and the agent arranged for shore medical follow up. The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authority. The SPCG boarded the ship at Eastern Boarding Ground “B” (PEBGB) and conducted a search and investigation.

area_description: Approximately 5.1 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, four perpetrators were sighted in the engine room. One of the perpetrators was armed with a long knife. The ship's general alarm was activated and crew mustered. After conducting a search onboard, master confirmed there was no further sighting of the perpetrators and some engine spares were stolen. All crew members were safe and accounted for. The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authority. The SPCG boarded the ship at Eastern Holding B Anchorage (AEHB) and conducted a search and investigation.

area_description: Approximately 6.5 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, four perpetrators (not armed) were sighted at the starboard gangway. The ship's general alarm was activated and crew mustered. After conducting a search onboard, master confirmed there was no further sighting of the perpetrators and nothing was stolen. There was no confrontation between the perpetrators and crew; and all crew members were safe and accounted for. The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authority.

area_description: Approximately 2.38 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, seven perpetrators armed with knives were sighted in the engine room. There was no confrontation with the crew. The master raised the general alarm and crew mustered. A search was carried out onboard with no further sightings of perpetrators. The crew were not injured. The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authority.

area_description: Approximately 13.2 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, three unarmed perpetrators were sighted on board the ship. The master initiated a security search with no perpetrators found onboard. The crew were not injured. Nothing was stolen. The incident was reported to Singapore POCC. The SPCG boarded the ship at Eastern Bunkering B Anchorage (AEBB) and conducted a search and investigation.

area_description: Approximately 3.2 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, five perpetrators boarded the ship. One of the perpetrators was armed with a knife. The ship’s general alarm was raised and crew mustered and accounted for. A search was carried out onboard with no further sightings of perpetrators. The crew were not injured. One crew’s mobile phone was stolen. The incident was reported to Safety Singapore VTIS. broadcast on anti-piracy watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information was shared with the Indonesian authority.

area_description: Manila International Container Terminal (MICT) Anchorage Area, Philippines
description: At Anchor While at anchor, the duty crew noted that the cover of the hawse pipe of the starboard anchor was opened. After informing the 2nd officer, the general alarm, including the typhoon alarm was raised. A search was conducted with no perpetrators found on board. Subsequently, the master ordered an inventory and inspection of the deck equipment. The crew were not injured. Some ship property/stores were stolen. The incident was reported to VTMS Corregidor and CGS Manila. CGS Manila immediately directed the duty maritime patrol (MARPAT) team to verify the incident, and advised the Master to strengthen onboard security measures and increase roving duties to prevent similar incidents.

area_description: Manila Bay Anchorage, Philippines
description: At Anchor While at anchor, a crew member was confronted by six perpetrators, reportedly armed with knives, at Bay 02 on the forward part of the ship. He was threatened, ordered to located remain silent, and confined in the bosun store beneath the forward mooring station. The crew member later freed himself and activated the fire alarm. The perpetrators briefly returned but were unable to gain entry, and subsequently escaped from the ship via the deck leading overboard. An immediate search of the vessel was conducted, with no perpetrators found onboard. Subsequent investigation by the ship’s crew revealed that the padlock and securing arrangement of the bosun store door had been tampered with, indicating forced entry. The stern access to the engineer’s passageway was also found to have been tampered with. A walkie-talkie and two hydrant caps were reported stolen. The company was notified, and the incident was reported to the local coast guard and customs authorities through the local agent.

area_description: Vicinity Waters off Cavite City, Philippines
description: At Anchor While at anchor, the crew noticed that several items, namely cable wires and parts of the ship's beam, were missing from the ship. The master subsequently confirmed that no other losses or damages were sustained, and that no further assistance was required. The crew were not injured. Upon receipt of the report, CGS Manila immediately directed CGSS Cavite City to conduct MARPAT operations and establish contact with the ship. Thereafter, all CGSS within the Cavite area were directed to conduct shore patrols and maintain heightened vigilance, particularly for possible sightings or recovery of the stolen items.

area_description: Vicinity waters off Bauan, Batangas, Philippines
description: At Anchor While at anchor, a seaborne patrol personnel of CGSS Bauan saw one of the perpetrators climbing the ship from an unnamed motor banca. The Philippine Coast Guard team immediately apprehended the perpetrator, and found a knife onboard the motor banca. A comprehensive search of the ship was conducted by the combined teams of CGSS Bauan and Special Operations Group Southern Tagalog. Three additional perpetrators were found onboard the ship, and all four perpetrators were turned over to the Investigation and Detection Unit - Southern Tagalog. Nothing was stolen.

area_description: Approximately 6 nm off Pulau Nongsa (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, the master of the tug boat observed three sampans around the barge and three perpetrators on the barge taking scrap metals from the barge. About half an hour later, the perpetrators were sighted leaving in the sampans. The tug boat and barge continued their voyage and no assistance was required. All crew members were accounted for and without injury. Some scrap metals were stolen. The master reported the incident to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcasts on anti-piracy watch were initiated to remind all vessels to maintain vigilant watch at all times in the SS. RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. Information of the incident was also shared with Indonesian Authority.

area_description: Approximately 2.6 nm off Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, six perpetrators armed with knives were sighted at the steering gear room. The ship’s general alarm was raised. All crew members mustered and were accounted for. A search was carried out with no perpetrators found onboard. The crew members were not injured and some engine spares were stolen. The master reported the incident to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcasts on anti-piracy watch were initiated to remind all vessels to maintain vigilant watch at all times in the SS. RSN and SPCG were notified of the incident. SPCG boarded the vessel for security check at Singapore Anchorage but did not find any perpetrators on board. Information of the incident was also shared with Indonesian Authority.

area_description: Batangas Anchorage, southeast of Brgy San Pedro, Bauan, Batangas, Philippines
description: at anchor, several firefighting equipment and shipboard fittings were found missing from the open deck areas during a safety security round of the ship. It is believed that perpetrators boarded the ship during night time and stole the items. The incident was reported to the company, local agents, and VTMS Batangas. Additional security rounds were implemented, and all remaining bronze were removed from the open deck and secured on board as a preventive measure. CGS Batangas directed CGSS Bauan and CGSS Mabini to intensify seaborne patrols and conduct periodic radio announcements to all nearby ships in anchorage area to remain vigilant against illegal activities.

area_description: Approximately 3.8 nm off Pulau Nongsa Beacon (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, the master of the tug boat observed one sampan alongside the barge with approximately five perpetrators sighted on the barge taking scrap metals. About 40 minutes later, the perpetrators were sighted left in the sampans. The tug boat and barge continued their voyage and no assistance was required. All crew members were accounted for and without injury. Some scrap metals were stolen. The master reported the incident to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcasts on anti-piracy watch were initiated to remind all vessels to maintain vigilance.

area_description: Approximately 4.1 nm off Pulau Nongsa Beacon (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, approximately six perpetrators were sighted onboard the barge with three sampans alongside. At 1410 hrs, the master updated that the perpetrators escaped from the barge, and all three sampans departed from the area. Some scrap metals were reported stolen. The tug boat and barge continued their voyage and no assistance was required. All crew members were accounted for and without injury. The master reported the incident to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcasts on anti-piracy watch were initiated to remind all vessels to maintain vigilance.

area_description: Batangas Anchorage, Philippines
description: At Anchor While at anchor, perpetrators from one motor banca boarded the ship and stole some cables. The incident was reported to PCG Substation Bauan. The PCG apprehended one perpetrator onboard the motor banca and conducted comprehensive search onboard and apprehended another four perpetrators. The perpetrators were charged under Violation of Article 122 of the revised Penal Code as Amended by R.A 7659- Piracy in General and Mutiny on the High Seas or in Philippine waters.

area_description: In the eastbound lane of the Traffic Separation Scheme (TSS)
description: While underway, nine perpetrators from three sampans were sighted alongside the barge removing scrap metals while the tug and barge were enroute from Singapore to Vietnam. After observing that all nine perpetrators had departed the barge, the master resumed the eastbound passage. At 1510 hrs, three sampans with nine perpetrators were again observed alongside barge taking scrap metals. At 1525 hrs, the three sampans departed from the barge. The crew was not injured. The master reported the incident to Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS). Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was initiated to remind all vessels to maintain vigilance.

area_description: Tangkil Island Anchorage, Indonesia
description: At Anchor While at anchor, the duty crew on routine rounds spotted ropes attached with hooks on the poop deck railings and immediately informed the bridge. Alarm was raised and crew mustered. Four perpetrators armed with knives were sighted escaping with stolen engine spares. The crew members were not injured. The incident was reported to port authority through local agent. PRC relayed the message to Indonesia Marine Police HQ.

area_description: Approximately 2.66 nm from Pulau Ramunia (Malaysia), in the westbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, the master reported that two motorised small boats with five perpetrators onboard came alongside the barge. Four perpetrators were sighted stealing iron scrap from the barge. One of the small boats came alongside for a second time with three perpetrators and transferred scrap metals to the sampan. The master immediately mustered the crew and reported the incident to the shipping company and Singapore Police Coast Guard (PCG). Singapore PCG arrived at the spot and assisted by shadowing the barge. There was no confrontation with the perpetrators and no injuries to the crew. Some scrap metals were reported stolen.

area_description: Approximately 5.4 nm from Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, the master reported that three perpetrators with batons were sighted in the engine room. The ship’s general alarm was activated and the crew mustered. A search was conducted with no perpetrators found onboard. All crew members were accounted for and without injury. Some engine spare parts were reported stolen. The master reported the incident to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was initiated to remind all vessels to maintain vigilance. The Republic of Singapore Navy’s (RSN) Maritime Security Task Force (MSTF) and Singapore PCG were notified of the incident. Information of the incident was shared with the Indonesian authorities. Upon arrival in Singapore, Singapore PCG boarded the vessel for security check with no perpetrators found.

area_description: Approximately 2.74 nm from Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, the 2nd engineer sighted four perpetrators the steering gear room without armed with knives at confrontation. The ship alarm was raised and deck lighting was switched on. A search was conducted with no perpetrators found onboard. All crew members were accounted for and without injury. Some engine spare parts were stolen. The master reported the incident to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was initiated to warn all vessels to always maintain a vigilant watch in the Singapore Strait (SS). The RSN and Singapore PCG were notified of the incident. Singapore PCG boarded the vessel for security check at Singapore Anchorage with no sighting of perpetrators. Information of the incident was shared with the Indonesian authority.

area_description: Approximately 4.8 nm from Batu Behanti beacon (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While underway, two sampans were sighted alongside the towing barge and about 15 to 20 perpetrators were onboard the barge. The perpetrators then left the barge with some scrap metals. All crew members were accounted for with no injuries and no assistance required. The master immediately reported the incident to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was initiated to remind all vessels to maintain vigilance.

area_description: Off Batu Berhanti (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS
description: While the tug boat towing barge was underway, the master reported to Singapore VTIS that a small boat with four to five perpetrators was alongside the barge and were removing the scrap metal on the barge. Over the next hour, several other small boats arrived and departed in phases, with a peak of seven boats engaged in In total, removing the scrap metal from the barge. approximately 45 perpetrators in 11 small boats were observed. Singapore VTIS was kept updated and crew safety was confirmed throughout. The company subsequently instructed the master to cross towards Singapore. The small boats later dispersed upon the approach of a Singapore PCG vessel. A small boat tried to return but escaped following the intervention of the Singapore PCG vessel. The tug boat and barge subsequently resumed their voyage to Vietnam. All crew members were accounted for, with no injuries reported.
